$comment: What each error means and what to do, for clipmux.com/docs/reference/errors. scripts/generate-reference.mjs adds each HTTP code's status and routes from the OpenAPI spec, and fails if the spec has a code this file doesn't explain.

http.invalid_request: The body or a parameter is malformed or out of range; `message` names it. Fix the request; retrying the same one fails again.
http.invalid_cursor: The `cursor` is not one this API returned. Start again without it, or pass the `next_cursor` you were given.
http.invalid_parts: Some parts are missing or their ETags don't match what storage holds. List the stored parts, upload the rest, and complete again.
http.import_url_refused: The URL is not a public http(s) URL, or it carries credentials. Use a public URL, or upload the file instead.
http.unauthorized: No credential, or a wrong or revoked one. Check the API key or upload token; `npx @clipmux/node doctor` checks an app's key.
http.token_expired: The playback token's `exp` has passed. Fetch a new token and retry; `<clipmux-player>` does this by itself.
http.insufficient_scope: The API key lacks the scope this route needs. Create a key with it: `uploads:write`, `assets:read` and `assets:write` are the defaults, `analytics:read` is asked for.
http.denied: The token is valid but doesn't cover this request: another playback ID or app, a poster-only token, or a revoked signing key. Stop; don't retry.
http.upload_mismatch: The upload token belongs to another upload. Use the token returned with this upload.
http.not_found: No such object in this app, or it was revoked. For playback, the ID is unknown or revoked.
http.agent_source_not_found: The PC agent's file is unknown, or was already attached. Push it again with `clipmux push --local`.
http.pairing_not_found: The pairing is unknown, or its credentials were already collected. Start a new pairing.
http.share_not_found: The share link is unknown or revoked, its video was deleted, or its app is disabled.
http.share_expired: The share link has expired. Make a new one.
http.share_revoked: The share link was revoked. Make a new one.
http.asset_deleted: The video was deleted. Nothing more can change it.
http.asset_not_ready: The video isn't ready yet. Wait for `video.asset.ready`, then retry.
http.job_active: Another job is changing this video; `job_id` names it. Wait for it, or pass `supersede: true` to cancel it.
http.no_audio: The video has no audio track, so there is nothing to transcribe.
http.subtitles_not_ready: Chapters are made from subtitles, which aren't ready. Make subtitles first, or wait for them.
http.chapters_not_connected: No LLM is connected for chapters. Connect one under Captions and AI in the dashboard.
http.track_not_ready: The track isn't ready yet. Wait for `video.asset.track.ready`.
http.source_missing: The video's source file was not kept, so it can't be re-encoded.
http.source_unavailable: The source stays on a PC agent that was revoked. Push it again from a connected PC.
http.too_many_playback_ids: A video has at most 1000 playback IDs. Revoke some first.
http.upload_not_active: The upload has already completed, been cancelled or expired. Create a new upload, with a new Idempotency-Key.
http.upload_missing: Storage no longer has this upload's parts. Create a new upload.
http.upload_expired: The upload wasn't completed in time. Create a new upload.
http.size_mismatch: The stored file's size differs from the `size` the upload declared. Create a new upload with the right size.
http.idempotency_in_progress: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running. Wait a moment and retry with the same key.
http.idempotency_key_reused: The Idempotency-Key was used with a different request. Use a new key for a new request.
http.too_large: The file is larger than this instance or its storage allows, or a request body is larger than its route accepts.
http.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait `Retry-After` seconds (also `retry_after` in the details), then retry.
http.too_many_pairings: Ten pairings are already waiting for the owner. Wait for one to be approved or to expire.

asset.upload_expired: The upload wasn't completed in time.
asset.import_too_large: The file at the URL is larger than this instance allows.
asset.import_url_refused: The URL, or a redirect it followed, is not public.
asset.unsupported_source: The file is not a video ffmpeg can read.
asset.processing_failed: Processing failed for another reason; the job's logs say why.
asset.source_download_failed: The worker couldn't download the source from storage.
asset.source_changed: The source in storage changed while it was being processed.
asset.source_missing: The source is no longer in storage.
asset.scratch_full: The worker didn't have the disk for the job: it saw before encoding that the ladder wouldn't fit, or the disk filled during the download or encode. The job may move to a fallback.
asset.job_timeout: The job ran past its time limit.
asset.worker_lost: The worker stopped answering mid-job, after every retry.
asset.worker_stopped: The worker was stopped mid-job, after every retry.
asset.commit_failed: The finished output couldn't be committed.
asset.upload_failed: The worker couldn't upload the output to storage.
asset.agent_unavailable: The PC agent holding the source is no longer connected.

track.transcribe_unavailable: No worker or speech API can transcribe now.
track.transcript_invalid: The transcript that came back was not valid.
track.speech_api_rejected: The speech API refused the request; check its key and model.
track.llm_not_connected: No LLM is connected for chapters.
track.llm_unavailable: The model kept failing, through three tries.
track.model_rejected: The model's provider refused the request; check its key and model.
track.model_refused: The model declined to write chapters for this transcript.
track.invalid_model_output: The model's chapters were still invalid after one corrective re-prompt.
track.transcript_too_large: The transcript makes a prompt over 512 KB, which is never truncated.
